get.description: Absent base_version means null (only no-head courses); never latest fallback. revise_scene requires base_version and scene_id. adjust_outline affects all scenes. Local instruction cannot change global example/goal; server rejects OUTLINE_ADJUSTMENT_REQUIRED. Preview is structural only and never classifies instruction. requires_outline_adjustment equals kind==adjust_outline.
Additive projection extension of frozen T001 route, merged only at T021 after both approvals; no current runtime change.

SceneProjection.description: Public additive projection for T001 readFreeCourseScene. Local checks require non-whitespace markdown, same-version anchors, actual step bounds and per-step element reference integrity.

PlanCandidate.description: Model structural candidate, not public REST body. Server binds actual request IDs/owner/scene UUIDs. Local checks verify source_key whitelist and real excerpts, unique IDs/terms/scene keys, preceding dependencies and objective references; size<=16KiB. Unknown graph links do not block.
